config.carrier: A18's config_for: drawdown, no write-off, no rescue
config.shock: freeze: a share of every live node's balance leaves the trading accounts and the claim total at the close of round 149 and comes back at the close of round 150; destroy: the same removal, never returned

criteria.detail: With no shock the driver touches nothing: on 61 configurations (the library default and every base cell of this grid at seed 0), 42 history fields and the closing state (claim total, holdings, parked, below the floor, and where every generator got to) compared bit for bit against Network.run(), 0 configurations differ. In every cell the claim total equals held plus parked at every yield, to 1e-09 of the opening stock: 1800 of 1800. Every freeze comes back node for node: 900 of 900. Every shocked cell's generators end where its twin's end: 1500 of 1500, so the two runs draw the same numbers and their difference is the shock's. The round loop's own asserts did not fire: all 1800 cells completed. Gate verdict: pass. State map: the driver identical to Network.run() on every gate configuration and the three checks above holding in every cell -> PASS; anything else -> FAIL; no gate section -> not judged, and --run does not start.

criteria.detail: Printed, not judged. tau is the first round after the shock from which the flow stays inside its twin's floor for 10 consecutive rounds; round 150 is k = 0. Floor = the twin's dispersion across seeds at the same round, band = 2.0 floors. Inside the floor is a statement against how much economies of this kind differ from seed to seed; the paired difference itself carries no noise, because the two runs draw the same numbers (A30-0), and what is left of it is A30-4's recovered share. State map: inside at once = the shock round is already inside the floor, so the shock is smaller than it: no reading; back within two rounds = back inside the floor within two rounds, and it stays there; back slowly = back inside the floor after more than two rounds, and it stays there; never back, above = never back inside the floor: the flow settles above its twin; never back, below = never back inside the floor: the flow settles below its twin; never back, swinging = never back inside the floor, and the tail sits on neither side of the band; one seed = one twin seed, so no floor: no reading. The band at the shock round as a share of the twin's flow: median 0.008443, 0.006873 to 0.066635.
